name: headless-stop
description: In a non-interactive run (claude -p: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=sdk-cli or CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0, or LIVING_MEMORY_HEADLESS=1) the Stop reminder keeps the closing nothing-durable line and ends with the instruction to repeat the answer in full; an attended run never gets it. A read-only session gets no housekeeping reminder (map) however much it explored, and an edit later in the session brings it back.

payload.prompt: remember that the staging server was retired

expect.reminder_ends_with: This is a non-interactive run and only your last message is returned: after saving, end with your answer to the task repeated in full.

payload.prompt: remember that the build box is slow
remember that the cache is cold on Mondays

expect.reminder_ends_with: This is a non-interactive run and only your last message is returned: after saving, end with your answer to the task repeated in full.

payload.prompt: look around the hivemind app and answer what it does
now fix the typo in the hivemind app

reminder_contains: hivemind, which has no codebase map
expect.reminder_ends_with: This is a non-interactive run and only your last message is returned: after saving, end with your answer to the task repeated in full.
